entities.name: System Information Block 17
entities.description: A system information block that is segmented and requires assembly from multiple segments.

entities.name: SIB17 Segment
entities.description: A partial segment of SIB17 that needs to be stored and assembled with other segments.

entities.name: SIB17 Information Elements
entities.description: The complete assembled information elements from all SIB17 segments.

entities.name: Value Tag Changed Condition
entities.description: Condition where the value tag of SIB17 has changed since previous segments were stored.

entities.name: All Segments Received Condition
entities.description: Condition where all segments of SIB17 have been successfully received.

entities.name: 3 Hour Timeout Condition
entities.description: Condition where complete SIB17 has not been assembled within 3 hours.

entities.name: Cell Reselection Condition
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE performs cell (re-)selection.

entities.name: Discard Stored Segments
entities.description: Action to discard all stored SIB17 segments.

entities.name: Store Segment
entities.description: Action to store a received SIB17 segment.

entities.name: Assemble SIB17
entities.description: Action to assemble SIB17-IEs from all received segments.

relations.description: Value tag change condition triggers discarding of stored segments.
Reception of SIB17 triggers storage of segments.
All segments received condition triggers assembly of SIB17-IEs.
3 hour timeout condition triggers discarding of stored segments.
Cell reselection condition triggers discarding of stored segments.
Assembly action produces the complete SIB17 Information Elements.
